name: papermerge
description: Papermerge(https://www.papermerge.com/) is an open source document management system (DMS) primarily designed for archiving and retrieving your digital documents. Instead of having piles of paper documents all over your desk, office or drawers - you can quickly scan them and configure your scanner to directly upload to Papermerge DMS."

paths.name: Path: /data
paths.description: Storage location for all papermerge data files.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Specify an external redis instance to use. Can optionally include a port (`redis:6379`) and/or db (`redis/foo`). If left blank or not included, will use a built-in redis instance. If changed after initial setup will also require manual modification of /config/settings.py
